maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from recruiter subscriptions and job postings on Dice and ClearanceJobs, not repair, servicing or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Paid by private employers and recruiters, including defense contractors like Lockheed Martin, buying job postings and subscriptions on Dice and ClearanceJobs.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by selling subscriptions on Dice and ClearanceJobs; M&A is mentioned but only occasional deals, not a roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Job boards and recruiting subscriptions can be swapped for other platforms like LinkedIn; switching involves little downtime or re-qualification.

notes: ClearanceJobs has somewhat stickier niche access to cleared talent, but switching is still relatively easy.
